nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are ultra-processed foods (UPFs)?
nodes.answer: Ultra-processed foods (UPFs) are formulations of ingredients, mostly of exclusive industrial use, created by a series of industrial techniques and processes, including items like soft drinks, confectionery, mass produced breads, and reconstituted meat products.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How has the prevalence of ultra-processed foods changed globally?
nodes.answer: The prevalence of ultra-processed foods first grew in high-income countries but is now rapidly increasing in middle and low-income countries due to globalization and new growth opportunities in emerging markets.
